column1: # The libraries Ratchet & Clank 3 (PAL) calls, by entry point, and what the port does with
# each: the same columns and port values as port/game/rac1-pal/libraries.tsv.
# Found by the instructions: rows of rac2-ntsc's and rac1-pal's tables whose function has the same
# instructions here once addresses are masked ("the instructions of"), or the same shape of
# instructions where the SDK's version differs a little ("the shape of", checked by hand); the
# kernel's system-call wrappers by the call number each loads into $v1.
# A host row binds an entry point to the replacement of that name every game shares
# (port/game/common/libraries.tsv), or, with a signature of its own, to this game's host C
# (port/game/rac3-pal/host). Entry points not here run from their C, or from their assembly.
